articles.title: From Emperors to World Records: The Scoop on National Ice Cream Month
articles.summary: July marks National Ice Cream Month, a tradition since 1984. The average American eats 23 pounds of ice cream yearly, and a study suggests your favorite flavor might reveal your personality — vanilla fans are adventurous!

articles.title: BTS Opts Out of 2027 Grammys, Citing Concerns Over New 'Asian Pop' Category
articles.summary: BTS will not submit their comeback album 'ARIRANG' for Grammy consideration, each member announced on Instagram. The move follows the Recording Academy's introduction of a Best Asian Pop Music Performance category, which some fans see as limiting.

articles.title: Against the Current: How a Fry-Sized Fish Conquers Waterfalls
articles.summary: New research confirms that shellear fish in the Democratic Republic of Congo scale vertical rock faces at Luvilombo Falls. Using microscopic hooks on their fins, these tiny climbers battle rushing water for up to 10 hours per ascent.
